response.overview: A 17 year-old girl is going through a box of her late dad’s belongings with her best friend, while trying to process her grief. Meanwhile, her mum is processing the grief differently, struggling even to get out of bed. As Mia tries to distract herself from her grief, she becomes obsessive about going through the belongings.
response.tagline: As Mia goes through her late father's belongings with her best friend, she realises she knows less about him than she thought.
